method.communities: NetworkX Louvain; symmetrised summed weights; resolution 1; seed 42; self-loops excluded
method.filters: Local London start time. AM 07:00–09:59; PM 16:00–18:59. Weekends Saturday/Sunday (bank holidays remain weekdays).
method.strength: Arrivals + departures; a return to the same station contributes twice. Degree excludes self-loops.
method.resilience: Static deletion of 10% of active stations; share of observed trips whose endpoints remain. Random: 100 seed-42 samples. No rerouting or causal forecast.
